title: Ask HN: Please be more thoughtful when downvoting
guide_zh: 作者呼吁踩评论前多想一步，不要无解释地打压有建设性的发言。
author: guynamedloren
excerpt: Lately I've noticed far too many constructive comments that have been downvoted (usually without any explanation). Please stop this. It's okay to have comments that are not in support with the original post or your own thoughts. We don't have to shoot them down. Downvoting is meant as a management tool to filter out comments that negatively impact the community, or ones that provide no substance or insight. Please do not downvote legitimate comments. Thank you.
